requirements_summary: Workload: chat + ticket summarization. Targets: p95 < 400ms (interactive chat), avg token cost sensitivity. Throughput: low concurrent users (10-50 qps bursts). Model preference: smaller open/efficient variants (low-latency profiles) but will accept fallbacks. Key asks: 1) region recommendation (serve from us-east for majority of users), 2) timeout and retry guidance (client timeout ~4s, server timeout 15s, exponential backoff, jitter), 3) prompt length guidance (truncate ticket context to 400-600 tokens, use document search to retrieve context instead of sending full history), 4) enable streaming responses for perceived latency gains, 5) quick batching hints for low-latency small-batch workloads, 6) visibility: token-level cost and latency traces in console.
